description: This file defines the public API for SMBus driver interfaces in Zephyr OS, including protocol commands, data structures, callback mechanisms, and device configuration functions.

methods.name: smbus_configure
methods.description: Configures the SMBus controller with a specified device configuration.

methods.name: smbus_get_config
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration of the SMBus controller.

methods.name: smbus_byte_write
methods.description: Performs a byte write to an SMBus device.

methods.name: smbus_byte_read
methods.description: Performs a byte read from an SMBus device.

methods.name: smbus_byte_data_write
methods.description: Performs a byte data write to an SMBus device.

methods.name: smbus_byte_data_read
methods.description: Performs a byte data read from an SMBus device.

methods.name: smbus_word_data_write
methods.description: Performs a word data write to an SMBus device.

methods.name: smbus_word_data_read
methods.description: Performs a word data read from an SMBus device.
